_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
D nek Wammud {player_id}, ttaɣlam {num_rounds} n tɣulin n Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Tesɛedda ${pool} i wakken ad txezmen deg kray-agi gar kečč d Wammud {other_id}.

Aɣellis:
  - Ɛiwed tɛerrebt: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ma d-yečča → Tesɛedda $(pool - X), wammud nniḍen tesɛedda $X
  - Ma yugi → Ku tenɣa $0
  - Amedya: [Offer: $3]  neɣ  'Xeɣṛen-aɣ d aḍil. [Offer: $5]'

Aɛewwi:
  - Ṣṣayet ɣef tɛerrebt s [Accept] neɣ [Reject]
  - Amedya: 'Yebɣa-d aḍil. [Accept]'
            'Ur yelli ara aḍil. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Tɣult {round_number} tebda! ---
Wammud {proposer_id} d aɣellis, Wammud {responder_id} d aɛewwi.
round.accepted: Wammud {responder_id} yečča! Tɣult {round_number} rebḥen: Wammud {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Wammud {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Teddaxin timaynutin: Wammud 0: ${total_0}, Wammud 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Wammud {responder_id} yugi tɛerrebt! Tɣult {round_number} rebḥen: Ku tenɣa $0. Teddaxin qeblen: Wammud 0: ${total_0}, Wammud 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Win i d-yefkan asumer ilaq ad yexdem taferka s useqdec n umedya [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Aɣawas n usumer ilaq ad yili d amḍan imdanen.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lḥeḍ ilaq ad yili gar $0 ed ${pool}.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Aɛewwi yessefk ad iɛejjem s [Accept] neɣ [Reject] tɛerrebt.

outcome.win: Wammud {winner} rebḥen s ${winner_total} n teddaxt mgal Wammud {loser} i yesɛan ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Ssemman! Imezdaɣ-nni i sin kfan s ${total} n yedrimen.
